query: UPDATE app.corporate_client SET status = 'pending_verification', submission_round = submission_round + 1, submitted_at = $4, updated_at = $4, updated_by = $3, legal_name = COALESCE($5, legal_name), nib = COALESCE($6, nib), npwp = COALESCE($7, npwp), office_address = COALESCE($8, office_address), office_phone = COALESCE($9, office_phone) WHERE id = $1 AND submission_round = $2 AND status = 'rejected' AND deleted_at IS NULL
